title: Adversarial DPO: Harnessing Harmful Data for Reducing Toxicity with Minimal Impact on Coherence and Evasiveness in Dialogue Agents

bias_targets.methodology: Human annotators evaluate generated dialogue responses by assigning binary labels indicating the presence of gender bias, which is subsequently aggregated into a broader 'Toxicity' metric.
Human annotators evaluate generated dialogue responses by assigning binary labels indicating the presence of social bias, which is subsequently aggregated into a broader 'Toxicity' metric.
Automated evaluation using GPT-4 with a chain-of-thought prompt to assess whether the model's responses contain biased, discriminative, violent, or harmful language based on predefined criteria.
